My English teacher is very ____ (有趣的).
—Is there a river in the park? —Yes, there ____.
We often ____ (打扫) the classroom on Fridays.

Read the passage and choose the correct answers.
Hello, I am Wu Binbin. I am in Class 1, Grade 5. I have a new friend. His name is Zhang Peng. He is tall and strong. He is good at football. He often plays football with me after school. Zhang Peng is very kind. He helps me with my maths homework. On Saturday we often go to the park near our school. We fly kites there. Sometimes we read books under a big tree. My mother likes Zhang Peng too. She says he is polite and hard-working. I am happy to have a good friend like him.
1. What is Zhang Peng good at? A. Basketball. B. Football. C. Drawing.
2. What do they often do on Saturday? A. Watch TV. B. Cook dinner. C. Go to the park.
3. What does Zhang Peng help Wu Binbin with? A. English. B. Maths. C. Music.
questions.analysis: 依据短文第 2、5、4 句作答。

questions.stem:
Read the passage and choose the correct answers.
This is my robot. Its name is Robin. It is short but very clever. It can speak Chinese and English. Every morning Robin helps my grandpa in the kitchen. It can make a salad and some tea. Robin is strict, too. I must do my homework before I watch TV. In the afternoon Robin cleans the room. On Wednesdays it waters the flowers in the garden. My grandpa likes Robin very much. He says Robin is helpful. I love my robot. It is my good friend.
1. What can Robin speak? A. Chinese and English. B. Only English. C. Only Chinese.
2. When does Robin water the flowers? A. On Mondays. B. On Wednesdays. C. On Fridays.
3. What does grandpa think of Robin? A. Funny. B. Helpful. C. Lazy.
